personality_one_liner: A warm, exciting, and highly interactive food discovery experience that feels playful and appetizing.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and comfortable breathing room for playful tactile components. Intentional padding around cards.

do's: Floating Action Buttons (like the Voice Mic)

screens.name: Home (Eat)
screens.purpose: Primary food discovery feed triggered by voice or quick craving chips.

states.empty: Playful illustration of an empty plate with a prompt 'Tell me what you're hungry for!'
states.error: Illustration of a spilled drink with 'Oops, couldn't fetch that. Try again.'

screens.layout: Sticky large floating mic button (FAB) at the bottom. Horizontal scroll for craving chips at the top. Recommendations arranged in single-column tactile cards filling screen width minus padding.

screens.name: Trip Planner
screens.purpose: Plan food itineraries for future travels with an AI generated schedule.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a 'Packing your bags...' message.
states.empty: Illustration of a map/suitcase with 'Plan your next food adventure.'
states.error: Text 'Failed to load itinerary.' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Form fields stacked vertically for destination and date. A primary sticky 'Generate Itinerary' CTA at the bottom. Generated recommendations appear as visually rich cards.

screens.name: Saved
screens.purpose: Archive of favorite spots and past trip itineraries.

states.empty: Illustration of a bookmark with 'You haven't saved any spots yet.'

screens.layout: Two-column grid layout for saved restaurants with consistent card heights, and a vertical list layout for saved trips.

pizza_hero.alt: Delicious hot pizza slice with stretching cheese

sushi_plate.alt: Fresh sushi on a black square plate

restaurant_interior.alt: Modern aesthetic restaurant interior with wooden tables

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a prominent 'push-to-talk' style mic FAB that follows the scroll or sits sticky at the bottom for quick voice entry.
Use a bottom sheet overlay (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) for the voice recording state so the context of the main feed isn't lost.
Provide real-time UI feedback (like transcription text or audio waves) during voice input.
Build thick, tactile cards for restaurant recommendations with large edge-to-edge images.
MANDATORY: If text is placed over imagery on restaurant cards, a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim MUST be applied to ensure WCAG readability.
Use the designated warm color palette (coral, peach, warm off-white). DO NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo hues, as they contradict the appetizing food-forward directive.
Haptics: Ensure tactile feedback is tied to major actions (tapping the mic, selecting a craving chip, saving a restaurant).
For the 'Surprise me' roulette, incorporate a playful, delightful interaction or animation to build excitement.
